reason: It's close to my side of town and I can actually feel the fabric and try the length on before paying, which is the only way I buy now. If the $45 everyday abaya isn't see-through or scratchy I'd take one and maybe a hijab, but I'm not spending $80 to $120 on a thobe or jalabiya with no Eid coming up.
objection: Is the crepe thin, see-through or scratchy once I'm under the fitting room light? A lot of TikTok shops look nice on video and feel cheap in your hand, and thobes and jalabiyas aren't really what I wear for South Asian weddings.
